content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: in both sessions, input on the Ir Swap Trade Date combobox is followed by two visible error events, then the user moves to Counterparty and Notional and leaves the screen through Static Data \u2192 Counterparty, returning to Ir Swap via the Trades tab, which fits a validation problem on Trade Date that drives the repeated screen re-opens.", "fix": "Fix: On the Ir Swap screen, change the Trade Date combobox so its validation error appears inline beside that field with the accepted format, and make the Counterparty and Notional values persist when the user goes to Static Data and returns through the Trades tab.", "cited_event_ids": ["50", "52:a53", "56:a58", "app:4", "app:32", "app:37", "49", "51:a56", "56:a66"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text or cause of the error messages is not in the events.", "Whether the Trade Date value, Counterparty, or Notional values persist after returning to Ir Swap is not visible.", "Why users opened Static Data / Counterparty is not shown; the link between the errors and the return trips is inferred from ordering only.", "Event ids such as 'app:4' and '50' repeat across the two sessions; citations assume they refer to the session in which they appear.", "Insight reports no abandonment and zero median time lost, so impact beyond repeated navigation is not established.", "No coverage overlays are tied to the Trade Date errors."]}
